name: Joshi
source:
A mysterious girl who's seen walking around the city with an injured leg. 

[Spoiler]She was incorrectly identified as Minamisawa Senri. 

Died by suicide on October 23rd, becoming the 5th victim in the Return of the New Generation Madness cases.[/spoiler]

[Based on the [url=https://chaoschild2.fandom.com/wiki/Riko_Haida]wiki[/url]] 

[Spoiler]She wasn't actually born June 7th, but was born the same year as Minamisawa Senri.[/spoiler]
